card.name: Location words before levels or based
card.fires_on: A modifier noun or adjective that names a place or medium, such as tissue, blood, Internet, vaginal, or systemic. It comes right before a word like levels, -based, or work.

modes.label: Body site before levels
modes.description: A body-site word such as blood or tissue sits right before the word levels.
modes.example: may result in increased and prolonged<< blood>> levels of ampicillin and sulb

modes.label: Internet before based or release
modes.description: The word Internet is used as a modifier for a web resource.
modes.example: interactive,<< Internet>>-based, searchable database created as a tool

modes.label: Other place modifiers
modes.description: Words such as yard, foreign, vaginal, or systemic modify the next noun.
modes.example: the physical activity accumulated during gardening and other<< yard>> work.

card.writes: It favors continuations like -based, Mounted, and Presence, and discourages overseas, online, and offshore.
